_doc: Compute options for the Phase 1 estimator: electrical power p_compute [W], mass added over a flight-controller-only build m_compute [kg], and end-to-end p99 latency of the mission's perception-to-actuation pipeline latency_s [s]. All values are ILLUSTRATIVE until Phase 2 measures them. latency_s = null means the option runs no onboard perception, so missions that need it are infeasible.

fc-only.description: Flight-controller MCU only (STM32H7 class), no companion computer

efficient-companion.description: Efficient companion SoC (Dragonwing / Ventuno Q class)

orin-nx-15w.description: NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, 15 W mode, with carrier and cooling

agx-orin-40w.description: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, 40 W mode, with carrier and cooling
